name: Budget
description: Reserve-then-settle budgets on the instance, in units the deployment names. Each meter counts what the instance has used and the reservations it holds against its limit. A reservation that does not fit here, or in an enclosing scope that a Links link points at, is refused, and the whole chain is left as it was. Usage is never refused: it draws the instance's own reservation down, counts here and in every enclosing scope, reports each instance it takes over its limit, and can move the status of each through escalate. checkReserve answers whether a reservation would fit now, which Queue copies so that work over its budget is not tried. On a type that composes Lease, a reservation lives as long as the lease it was made under.

meters.description: The meters, by name: camelCase, at most 64 characters.

limit.description: The most the instance may have used and reserved together; with limitField, the limit while the field holds no value of at least 0. No limit of its own when neither gives one.

limitField.description: An integer field of the type that holds the instance's limit; while it holds no value of at least 0, limit is the limit, and without limit there is none. Only a principal with limitPermission changes it once the instance exists.

reserve.description: The amount reserve takes for the meter when it is given no meter: what a claim reserves. With reserveField, the amount when the field holds no positive integer.

reserveField.description: An integer field of the type whose positive value is the amount reserve takes for the meter when it is given no meter, in place of reserve.

scope.description: A link of the type's Links config whose target is the enclosing scope: its schema composes Budget with the same meter, and every reservation and usage of the meter here is taken there too, and on up its own scope.

reset.description: daily: the used amount starts again at 0 at each UTC day; reservations are kept.

limitPermission.description: The permission a principal needs to change a meter's limit, with setLimit or through limitField. Absent, no limit changes once the instance exists.

onExceeded.description: A directive sent to the holder of the instance's active lease, through Lease's direct, when usage takes the instance or an enclosing scope over its limit: once per meter per lease. Needs Lease on the type.

direct.description: The directive's name. Its data is { meter, used, limit, scope }, scope being the instance over its limit as { schema, id }.

escalate.description: Moves the instance's Workflow status when usage leaves it over the limit of a meter, while the status is one of from, in the transaction of that usage: an instance's own usage, or one an instance inside it passes up, so a scope's config moves the scope. A move a guard vetoes or the caller may not make leaves the status, and the usage counts all the same. Needs Workflow on the type.

transition.description: The state to move to, through Workflow's transition.

from.description: The states the status moves from; in any other state it stays.

fields.name: budget
fields.description: Each meter, by name: used, reserved (this instance's own reservation and what it holds for the instances inside it), limit and remaining (limit minus used and reserved), limit and remaining null when the meter has no limit. A daily meter whose day has passed shows used 0.

operations.name: reserve
operations.description: Reserves an amount of one meter, or of every meter the config gives a reservation, for the instance and every enclosing scope. Refused when the instance or an enclosing scope cannot fit it, and then nothing is reserved anywhere. On a type that composes Lease it needs an active lease, and the reservation is settled when that lease ends.

meter.description: The meter; every meter with a configured reservation when absent.

amount.description: How much to reserve of the meter; its configured reservation when absent. Needs meter.

reserved.description: What this call reserved, by meter.

operations.name: checkReserve
operations.description: Whether reserve with the same parameters would fit now, here and in every enclosing scope, after the reservations of a lease that is no longer active are settled, as reserve settles them; it changes nothing and does not ask for a lease. Queue copies its answer so that a claim that cannot fit is not tried.

meter.description: The meter; every meter with a configured reservation when absent.

amount.description: How much of the meter; its configured reservation when absent. Needs meter.

until.description: When it does not fit: the start of the next UTC day, when the daily meters starting again make it fit with nothing else changing; null when only a change can make it fit, and when it fits.

scopes.description: The enclosing scopes the answer read, innermost first, each with the values of it the answer turns on: a move of one can change it.

hears.description: The values of the scope the answer turns on, as a reference hears them: a JSON pointer into the scope's data, and, for a number, the value it changes at when it crosses it. The meter's remaining, which the reservation fits while it is at or above the number; where a daily meter keeps it out now, the scope's reserved and limit; and the link to the scope's own scope.

operations.name: recordUsage
operations.description: Records usage of a meter, which is never refused. The part of it the instance's own reservation covers is released, here and in every enclosing scope, and the usage counts in each of them. Reports every instance of the chain whose usage is over its limit after it, moves the status of each whose config gives escalate, and sends onExceeded's directive to the holder of the active lease once per meter per lease.

used.description: The instance's usage of the meter after this call.

released.description: The part of the instance's own reservation the usage drew down.

overruns.description: Every instance of the chain whose usage of the meter is over its limit after this call, this one first, then outward.

escalated.description: Whether its escalate moved its status in this call.

directed.description: Whether this call sent onExceeded's directive.

operations.name: settle
operations.description: Releases the instance's own reservation of one meter, or of every meter, here and in every enclosing scope.

meter.description: The meter; every meter when absent.

released.description: What this call released, by meter.

operations.name: setLimit
operations.description: Sets a meter's limit on the instance, raising or lowering it; through limitField when the meter has one. Needs limitPermission, and is refused when the config names none, and below what the instance has used and reserved.

previous.description: The limit before; null when there was none.

operations.name: reserveFor
operations.description: Holds an amount of a meter for an instance whose scope link points here, as that instance's reserve does, and passes it on up this instance's own scope. Refused when the amount does not fit, when that instance does not draw the meter from here, and beyond what it has reserved and this instance does not hold for it yet.

schema.description: The schema of the instance inside this scope.

held.description: What this instance now holds of the meter for that one.

operations.name: settleFor
operations.description: Releases up to an amount of what this instance holds of a meter for another, never more than that one no longer holds itself, and passes the release on up this instance's own scope.

schema.description: The schema of the instance inside this scope.

operations.name: recordUsageFor
operations.description: Counts usage of a meter by an instance whose scope link points here, releases the part of what this instance holds for it that its own reservation covered, never more than that one no longer holds, and passes both on up this instance's own scope. Never refused for the amount.

schema.description: The schema of the instance inside this scope.

released.description: How much of its reservation the usage drew down.

overruns.description: This instance and every scope up from it whose usage of the meter is over its limit after the usage, innermost first.

escalated.description: Whether its escalate moved its status in this call.

vetoes.description: The reservation does not fit a meter's limit, here or in an enclosing scope (details.scope names which).
On a type that composes Lease, reserve needs an active lease.
The meter's reservation is held through a scope its link no longer points at; it is settled before a reservation through the new one.
A scope link does not change while a reservation is held through it.
A limit below what the instance has used and reserved.
A scope holds no more for an instance than that instance has reserved.
The config names no limitPermission, which changing a limit needs.
